name: Tembo Open Source Program
description: Tembo offers free access to its platform for open-source projects with OSI-approved licenses.

perks.title: Full Feature Access
perks.description: Full access to all Tembo features including AI agents, automations, and integrations

perks.title: Unlimited Contributors
perks.description: Unlimited contributors at no additional cost

perks.title: Free for Open Source
perks.description: No strings attached - keep using Tembo for free as long as your project remains open source

perks.title: GitHub Integration
perks.description: Seamless GitHub integration with your repositories and workflows

eligibility: Project must be publicly available on GitHub or GitLab
Licensed under MIT, Apache 2.0, or similar OSI-approved license
Applicant must be an owner or maintainer of the repository
Project should have active development and community engagement
applicationProcess: Apply through the Tembo OSS Program application page.
Tembo reviews the application for eligibility.
